coachProfile.bio2: In 2008, he founded <1>Brazilian Soccer Club</1> in Okinawa. For more than 17 years since, he has continued putting Brazilian-style development methods into practice in Japan.

faq.sectionSubtitle: Answers to the questions we hear most often from families

faq1.question: Can beginners join?
faq1.answer: Absolutely! Our Preschool class is designed for beginners, with careful coaching that starts from the basics. Children who are completely new to soccer are welcome to join with confidence.

faq2.question: Is the trial lesson free?
faq2.answer: Your first trial lesson is completely free. You'll take part in an actual lesson and get a feel for our Brazilian-style coaching and the overall atmosphere. We accept trial lesson requests at any time, so feel free to apply.

faq3.question: What is the Brazilian method?
faq3.answer: The Brazilian method is a coaching approach that trains technique, tactics, mentality, and discipline together as one. Beyond simply acquiring skills, it's designed to help players grow as people through soccer and become athletes who can compete on the world stage with confidence.

faq4.question: Is there a sibling discount?
faq4.answer: Yes, we offer a sibling discount: 10% off for a second child and 20% off for a third. We've set up these rates so families can enjoy soccer together at a great value.

faq5.question: What happens to lessons in the rain?
faq5.answer: In severe weather, safety comes first and a lesson may be cancelled. In that case, our makeup lesson system lets you attend a session on a different date. We'll let you know the available makeup dates in advance.

faq6.question: What do we need to bring when joining?
faq6.answer: Please bring clothes you can move in, soccer shoes (cleats or training shoes), a drink, and a towel. A uniform kit (¥16,000, including a training shirt, pants, and socks) is purchased at the time of enrollment. Soccer balls can also be borrowed from the school.

faq7.question: Can we join partway through the month?
faq7.answer: Yes, you can join at any time. If you enroll partway through the month, we'll prorate the fee accordingly, so there's nothing to worry about.

faq8.question: Do you offer career path consultation or support?
faq8.answer: Yes, especially in the Middle/High class, we provide career path consultation and support. We offer advice tailored to each player's goals, whether that's an overseas pro club, an overseas university soccer scholarship, or a top domestic team.

faq9.question: Can parents come and watch?
faq9.answer: Yes, we warmly welcome parents to come watch. You can see your child's progress up close. We also hold regular parent meetings to share updates on your child's growth and any challenges.

faq10.question: What kind of track record do you have?
faq10.answer: We have over 17 years of coaching experience and have produced more than 60 graduates. Among them are players who have represented Japan in beach soccer, joined professional clubs overseas, and enrolled in universities abroad on soccer scholarships — many are excelling at a high level.
